Equity split 80:20 CNGR:POSCO Future M (asiae writes it as 20:80 POSCO Future M:CNGR). capacity_ref_year 2026 = planned mass-production year, not a dated last phase. CNGR also has pCAM at IMIP/Morowali-type Indonesian bases per other press, not sourced here.

fields.asset_name: CNGR-Al Mada Morocco precursor plant (El Jadida region)

rows.notes: Capacity is the PLANNED phase-1 nameplate 120,000 t/yr NMC precursor (CRU 2023; S7 gives the same 12万吨 plan); the same CRU text lists 60,000 t/y LFP precursor and 30,000 t/y recycled material (S7 describes the 6万吨 as 磷酸铁锂, i.e. LFP; not entered as a FePO4 row because the product is ambiguous). CNGR's 2024 annual report (S1b) says the Morocco project 'started and was completed and commissioned in the same year' (2024), so status operational, but no installed/ramped capacity is disclosed and the built scale may be below 120 kt. capacity_ref_year = 2023 is the CRU publication-year fallback (CRU expected initial production 2025). start_year 2024 inferred from S1b (2024 annual report). Location 'El Jadida' from CRU/search summary; exact site (e.g. Jorf Lasfar) not confirmed from an opened page. Conflict: CRU 2023 expected initial production 2025; CNGR AR says commissioned in 2024.

rows.notes: GEM H1 2024 report (S9): Indonesia 50,000 t/yr high-nickel ternary precursor capacity to be commissioned progressively in H2 2024. A search summary of a later announcement (S10, page not opened, tier reported) says the first 30,000 t/yr line at IMIP, Morowali was completed ('已经建成竣工'); that supports status operational and installed 30,000 t but is snippet-only, so confidence <=0.5. installed_as_of unknown. GEM group-level: H1 2024 ternary-precursor sales >100 kt and 100% utilisation (GEM H1 2024 report p.12, not entered as a quote); 2024 full-year shipments 189 kt (China Merchants Securities broker note 2025-05-04, search snippet, not opened for quote). Jingmen/Taixing/Wuxi pCAM sites: no site capacity found.

Huayou 2023 board report (S12) says it 'started construction of the Indonesia 50,000 t ternary precursor project'; Yicai Global (S11, 2023-09-25) reports the Huayou/LG Chem agreement for an Indonesian precursor plant with annual output of 50,000 tons. The Sept 2023 agreement was non-binding (MoU). Exact site (Pomalaa vs Morowali) and current stage as of 2026 not confirmed; status is as of the 2023 report (May 2024 publication). capacity_ref_year 2024 = publication-year fallback. Possible overlap with 'Huayou Indonesia' references in cathode patch SC009 is not checked.
